intro: On Goldshire's upper floor, Zaldimar Wefhellt teaches young mages their first spells. When they outgrow his lessons, he sends them to Stormwind City for further training.

p: Upstairs at the Lion's Pride Inn, Zaldimar Wefhellt teaches novice mages the first arts of arcane, fire, and frost. When an apprentice outgrows those lessons, he sends them north to the Mage Quarter in Stormwind, where Jennea Cannon can teach them more.
